Description:
Bring a touch of natural wonder to your collection with this set of two medium-sized geodes. Each geode features a striking contrast between a rough stone exterior and sparkling crystal-lined interiors, revealed beautifully when split open. The raw, earthy exterior is typical for naturally formed geodes, while each center showcases mineral crystals that reflect the light, adding a captivating sparkle and depth to their natural design. Perfect for mineral collectors, crystal enthusiasts, or those who appreciate unique natural decor, these geodes offer visual interest and timeless appeal. Their sturdy stone composition ensures long-lasting beauty and durability, whether displayed as conversation pieces or used in educational settings to demonstrate natural geological processes. Both pieces show some typical surface weathering on the exterior, with intact and undamaged crystal interiors. There are no visible cracks or repairs. Ideal for display as-is or for use in rock and mineral studies. The set consists of two separate geodes, each with its own distinct crystal pattern and coloration
